sources.name: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities (federal)
sources.how_to_use: Search each city keyword (Harlingen, McAllen, Edinburg, Brownsville, Weslaco, Donna, Rio Grande City) with the Active filter on, then filter NAICS 236220, 238160 (roofing), 238210 (electrical), 238310 (drywall/insulation), 238120 (structural steel) and Place of Performance = TX. Public JSON API pattern: https://sam.gov/api/prod/sgs/v1/search/?index=opp&page=0&sort=-modifiedDate&size=25&mode=search&responseType=json&q=<QUERY>&qMode=ALL&is_active=true
sources.notes: SAM.gov's WAF returned HTTP 403 to every automated fetch from this research environment (API and opportunity pages), and the egress proxy also policy-blocked sam.gov, txsmartbuy.gov, txdot.gov and aggregator sites. Findings below come from search-engine indexing and must be verified live in a browser. Create a free SAM.gov account and set saved searches + email alerts.

sources.name: SAM.gov - VA Network Contracting Office 17 (VA Texas Valley Coastal Bend HCS: Harlingen HCC, Harlingen/McAllen/Weslaco clinics)
sources.how_to_use: All VA VISN 17 solicitations carry numbers starting with 36C257. Search '36C257' plus Harlingen, McAllen, or 'Valley Coastal Bend'; watch sources-sought notices, which precede SDVOSB set-aside construction solicitations.

sources.name: Texas ESBD - Electronic State Business Daily (TxSmartBuy)

All state solicitations over $25K post here. Individual solicitations resolve to txsmartbuy.gov/esbd/<solicitation-number>.

platforms.name: CivCastUSA
platforms.coverage: Texas-dominant civil/public-works bid platform — most TX city/county street, drainage, utility, and site work, including RGV cities/counties and their consulting engineers
platforms.cost: FREE for contractors (register, view/download plans, receive addenda); posting agencies/engineers pay per listing (~$99.99)
platforms.alerts: Create free account, set saved-search filters (TX; Hidalgo/Cameron/Willacy/Starr counties; keywords like 'roof', 'electrical'), enable email notifications for new matching projects and addenda
platforms.notes: Best single free source for RGV public/civil work; also use plan-holder lists to market your trades to bidding GCs.

platforms.name: DemandStar (OpenBids network)
platforms.coverage: Local-government network; active RGV agency pages include Harlingen CISD, Edinburg CISD, Weslaco ISD, South Texas College, City of Brownsville
platforms.cost: Free basic account (search all bids; $5/document; one free agency subscription); ~$100/yr for all agencies in up to 4 counties (doc fees waived in subscription area)
platforms.alerts: Subscribe to agencies/counties; automatic email when subscribed agencies post bids matching your commodity codes
platforms.notes: A $100/yr 4-county subscription covering Hidalgo+Cameron+Willacy+Starr captures several RGV entities at once.

platforms.name: BidNet Direct — Texas Purchasing Group
platforms.coverage: Statewide TX local-government group; RGV participants include City of Brownsville, City of Weslaco, Cameron County, City of Edinburg
platforms.cost: Free registration to view/respond to participating-agency bids; optional paid tier (~$120-200/yr) adds full statewide notification matching
platforms.alerts: Select NIGP codes and Texas region at registration; email notifications for matching solicitations; paid tier broadens matching
platforms.notes: Cameron County explicitly directs vendors to join the Texas Purchasing Group.

platforms.name: Bonfire (gobonfire.com portals)
platforms.coverage: Per-entity portals (<entity>.bonfirehub.com); RGV users include Mission CISD and Region One ESC; City of Brownsville FAQ also references Bonfire
platforms.cost: Free for vendors; register once per entity portal
platforms.alerts: Register on each entity's Bonfire portal and 'follow' opportunities; email notices for new postings and addenda

platforms.name: Public Purchase
platforms.coverage: Legacy e-procurement network; RGV agency pages exist for City of McAllen, City of Mission, City of Weslaco, South Texas College, Donna ISD, City of Mercedes
platforms.alerts: Register with the platform, then with each agency; select classification codes for automatic email bid notifications
platforms.notes: Many RGV agencies migrated to ProcureWare/OpenGov, but postings still syndicate here — worth the free registration.

platforms.name: ProcureWare
platforms.coverage: City of McAllen, City of Pharr, City of Mission bidding portals
platforms.alerts: Select commodity codes at registration; system auto-emails matching solicitations and addenda
platforms.notes: These three cities are among the biggest municipal builders in Hidalgo County — register on all three.

platforms.name: OpenGov Procurement
platforms.coverage: Hidalgo County, City of Edinburg, South Texas College
platforms.alerts: Click 'Subscribe' on each entity portal for email notices; 'Follow' individual solicitations for automatic addenda
platforms.notes: Hidalgo County is the region's largest county government — must-have registration.

platforms.name: Periscope S2G (mdf commerce)
platforms.coverage: Nationwide government marketplace; powers BuySpeed portals like Region One ESC's eBuyOne (esc1.buyspeed.com)
platforms.cost: Free basic supplier registration; paid S2G upgrade for multi-state matching
platforms.alerts: Register with NIGP codes; email notifications on matches
platforms.notes: Main RGV relevance is the Region One ESC eBuyOne registration.

platforms.name: Texas SmartBuy ESBD (Electronic State Business Daily)
platforms.coverage: All Texas state-agency solicitations over $25k — includes state building work in the Valley (TxDOT facilities, DPS, HHSC, UTRGV, TSTC)
platforms.cost: Free to search; CMBL (Centralized Master Bidders List) registration $70/yr puts you on required state bid lists; HUB certification free
platforms.alerts: Search ESBD by NIGP class/item codes; CMBL+HUB listing makes agencies solicit you directly; check weekly (no robust saved-search email natively)
platforms.notes: Get HUB certified (free) — state and many RGV local entities have HUB goals, and HUB listing generates inbound sub-bid requests from primes.

platforms.name: TxDOT Lettings
platforms.coverage: Monthly highway lettings; Pharr District covers all four RGV counties (illumination, signals = electrical opportunity)
platforms.cost: Free (plans free via Plans Online); only primes need prequalification, not subs
platforms.alerts: View 'Projects Currently Bidding' for the Pharr District; download plan-holder/bidder lists and market your trade directly to bidding primes; DBE directory listing brings inbound calls
platforms.notes: AGC of Texas plan room mirrors these lettings.

platforms.name: GovernmentBids.com
platforms.coverage: National government-bid aggregator incl. TX state/local
platforms.alerts: Daily email of matching bids by state and category
platforms.notes: Largely redundant if you register free on the actual RGV portals; useful only as a catch-all.

platforms.name: ConstructConnect
platforms.coverage: National commercial projects — public AND private; strong TX/RGV coverage with plans and GC bidder lists
platforms.alerts: Saved searches by CSI division + county/radius with daily email digests; identify bidding GCs and request ITBs
platforms.notes: One of the two big commercial databases.

platforms.name: Dodge Construction Network
platforms.coverage: National; largest private+public project database, tracking RGV commercial projects from planning through bid
platforms.alerts: Saved searches by trade/CSI, project stage, and geography with email alerts
platforms.notes: Best for early intel (projects in design) so you get on GC bid lists before bid day.

platforms.name: BuildCentral
platforms.coverage: Niche verticals (retail, medical, hotel, multifamily) nationwide incl. TX
platforms.alerts: Saved-search email alerts by project type/location
platforms.notes: Only worth it for a targeted vertical (e.g., medical construction in the McAllen-Edinburg corridor).

platforms.name: The Blue Book Building & Construction Network
platforms.coverage: National GC-to-sub network; many TX GCs send ITBs through it
platforms.cost: Free basic company profile (receive ITBs via BidScope/ONETEAM); paid ProView for marketing visibility
platforms.alerts: Complete free profile with your trades + RGV service area; GC invitations for McAllen/Brownsville projects arrive by email
platforms.notes: Passive inbound channel — the free profile is a no-brainer for a sub.

platforms.name: AGC of Texas (Highway/Heavy chapter) plan rooms
platforms.coverage: TxDOT and heavy/civil lettings statewide; member plan rooms
platforms.alerts: Member access to letting plans and bidder lists
platforms.notes: TxDOT's free letting page usually suffices for a sub; join only if steadily chasing highway electrical/illumination.

platforms.name: RGV AGC Plan Room (Rio Grande Valley AGC chapter)
platforms.coverage: THE local commercial plan room — 24/7 electronic plan room with plans/specs for most RGV commercial projects (public + private); physical plan rooms at 505 E Expressway 83, Pharr and 225 Industrial Dr, Brownsville
platforms.cost: Membership dues (only Valley-wide commercial construction association, since 1949)
platforms.alerts: Member plan-room notifications of new RGV projects bidding
platforms.notes: Highest-value local signup for a Valley subcontractor — nearly every commercial GC in the RGV is a member and pulls sub bids from its directory.

platforms.name: ABC — Texas Coastal Bend Chapter (covers RGV)
platforms.coverage: Merit-shop chapter serving the Coastal Bend AND Rio Grande Valley; member plan/bid resources
platforms.notes: No standalone RGV ABC chapter — RGV is served from Texas Coastal Bend (Corpus Christi); 'ABC South Texas' is the San Antonio chapter.

platforms.name: LRGVDC Procurement
platforms.coverage: Lower Rio Grande Valley Development Council RFPs/RFQs (facilities, Valley Metro transit buildings)
platforms.alerts: No alert system — bookmark and check monthly
platforms.notes: Also a gateway to member-city contacts.

community.name: RGV Contractors (Facebook group)
community.notes: Active RGV contractor group; members post sub needs, labor calls, and small-project leads.

community.name: RGV Contractors and Homeowners Community (Facebook group)
community.notes: Homeowners seeking bids plus contractors trading referrals — residential/light-commercial leads.

community.name: RGV CONTRACTING SERVICES (Facebook group)
community.notes: Contracting-services and lead-swapping group for the 956 area.

community.name: RGV Construction (Facebook page)
community.notes: ~48k-follower page covering commercial construction projects in the Valley — early intel on what's breaking ground and which GC has it.

community.name: r/RGV, r/McAllen, r/Brownsville (Reddit)
community.notes: No dedicated bid-posting threads found; occasional contractor-recommendation and hiring threads. Low value for bid capture — networking/reputation only. r/Construction (national) is useful for bidding-practice advice, not RGV leads.

community.name: UTRGV APEX Accelerator (formerly PTAC)
community.notes: TOP free resource. Sign up as a client via the website form or apex@utrgv.edu / (956) 665-7550 (ECESS Bldg 1.200, 1407 E Freddy Gonzalez Dr, Edinburg). Free one-on-one procurement counseling, help with SAM/CMBL/HUB/DBE certifications, and BID-MATCH emails — daily local/state/federal solicitations matched to your NAICS codes and keywords. Also runs procurement workshops and matchmaking events (calendar.utrgv.edu/group/apex).

community.name: UTRGV Small Business Development Center (SBDC)
community.notes: Free business advising (estimating, bonding readiness, financing) that complements APEX; same UTRGV economic-development umbrella.

community.name: RGV Partnership
community.notes: Valley-wide regional chamber/advocacy org; no bid board, but its member directory (business.rgvpartnership.com) lists agencies and GCs — a networking channel.

community.name: McAllen Chamber of Commerce
community.notes: No standing bid-notice page; hosts procurement/networking events. City of McAllen bids live on mcallen.procureware.com.

community.name: Brownsville Chamber of Commerce
community.notes: City Purchasing & Contracts Dept is a listed member; chamber circulates city/BPUB/Port opportunities to members. Also check Port of Brownsville bids (portofbrownsville.com/procurement_category/bids/) and BPUB purchasing (brownsville-pub.com).

community.name: Harlingen Area Chamber of Commerce
community.notes: Networking; city bids are on harlingentx.gov Finance > Bid Opportunities; Harlingen Housing Authority and Valley International Airport post separately.

community.name: RGV Hispanic Chamber of Commerce
community.notes: Actively pushes members toward HUB/MBE certification and government bid readiness; (956) 928-0060. Good source of prime-contractor teaming intros for a certified sub.

community.name: RGV AGC Plan Room (Rio Grande Valley AGC)
community.notes: The Valley's builders-exchange equivalent: 24/7 electronic plan room with plans/specs for most RGV commercial projects; physical plan rooms in Pharr (505 E Expressway 83) and Brownsville (225 Industrial Dr). Membership required — the single most important local signup for a commercial sub.

community.name: ABC Texas Coastal Bend Chapter
community.notes: ABC chapter covering Coastal Bend + RGV (no separate RGV chapter); member bid/plan resources and merit-shop GC network.

community.name: LRGVDC Procurement
community.notes: Lower Rio Grande Valley Development Council posts its own RFPs/RFQs (facilities, Valley Metro transit buildings); no alert system — bookmark and check.

community.name: Texas Public Notices (Texas Press Association)
community.notes: Free statewide search of newspaper legal notices — captures every RGV 'Notice to Bidders' that runs in The Monitor, Valley Morning Star, Brownsville Herald, Progress Times, etc. Search 'sealed bids'/'notice to bidders' filtered to those papers; supports saved searches with email alerts. Catches small entities (irrigation districts, housing authorities, small cities like Donna, San Benito, Raymondville, Rio Grande City) that use no e-portal.

community.name: MyRGV.com legal notices (The Monitor / Valley Morning Star / Brownsville Herald — AIM Media Texas)
community.notes: The three RGV dailies share MyRGV.com; statutory bid ads for Hidalgo/Cameron/Willacy entities run here (e.g., Cameron County advertises in the Brownsville Herald and Valley Morning Star). Use texaspublicnotices.com as the searchable front end; Progress Times (progresstimes.net) carries Mission/La Joya/Sharyland-area bid ads including McAllen ISD notices.
